purpose: Exercise the Stage D YAAP 16 framework, product and haotian hardware implementation with the stock audio HAL VINTF declarations restored, in a non-flashing multi-partition DSU while retaining the installed kernel, kernel modules, boot chain and firmware.
host_baseline: HyperOS OS3.0.304.0.WOBCNXM; runtime kernel remains the device-installed third-party 6.6.143 build

omitted_partitions.system_dlkm,vendor_dlkm: The installed third-party 6.6.143 kernel remains active during DSU. Loading module partitions built for the ROM prebuilt 6.6.77 kernel would create an avoidable kernel-module/KMI mismatch.
omitted_partitions.boot,init_boot,vendor_boot,dtbo,recovery: DSU does not replace the boot chain; these images remain outside this non-flashing upper-partition profile.
omitted_partitions.vbmeta,vbmeta_system: Each selected DSU image receives an independently verified Algorithm NONE hashtree footer. Reusing the complete OTA vbmeta chain would couple the package to omitted boot and dlkm partitions.
omitted_partitions.firmware: The installed HyperOS OS3.0.304.0.WOBCNXM firmware remains authoritative and is not written by DSU.
